name: @kanzo-tech/theme
description: Kanzo design tokens — a tenant palette document compiled to CSS, plus the four non-colour axes (radius / font / mono font / density) driven by data-* attributes on <html>.

scripts.//gen: Three steps, in this order: the derivation made runnable from plain Node (its own tables, then its build), the four non-colour axes, and the default tenant's document compiled into tokens.css.
scripts.gen: pnpm --filter @kanzo-tech/palette gen && node scripts/gen-theme.mjs && node scripts/gen-palette.mjs

//deps: No React peer: this package ships tokens, the axis table and types. The provider that consumes them lives in @kanzo-tech/ui.
//devDeps: @kanzo-tech/palette is a devDependency and must stay one — scripts/gen-palette.mjs and the tests derive with it, a browser never does. `boundary.test.ts` fails the build if it moves.
